in_marathi.name: सागर
in_marathi.long_meaning: सागर हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sagara’, meaning ‘ocean’. In Hindu mythology, Sagar is the name of a king, the father of the Asuras. The term can also be used metaphorically to describe vastness and depth.

in_bengali.name: सागर
in_bengali.long_meaning: सागर একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sagara’, meaning ‘ocean’. In Hindu mythology, Sagar is the name of a king, the father of the Asuras. The term can also be used metaphorically to describe vastness and depth.
